projects.title: Senior Software Project - Flow
projects.description:
Developed a React Native application for a smart home device used for tracking home water usage

• Worked as a team of 5 students to design, develop, and create documentation for a mobile
application to track home water consumption.
• Used an Arduino and flow meter to send water usage from a shower to our DigitalOcean server.
• Created Android and iOS mobile applications using React Native to display dynamic water
usage graphs.
• Adopted SCRUM/AGILE methodologies for better flexibility and used Github for version control.
